sphere_commentary.overview:
Dataset shows 1000 outcome scores across 30 protocols with stable means but meaningful protocol-level variance.
• HEALING leads slightly (mean 6.98) with lowest spread, consistent with nervous system regulation design.
• THRIVING matches HEALING (mean 6.96) with notably strong Focus protocols.
• TRANSFORMING trails (mean 6.59) with widest spread (std 1.87), aligned with ascending-arc design intent.
• Multiple analyzers converge on X-MC-L3 and crisis protocols as underperforming relative to AutoGluon predictions.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
Series patterns align with design intents, though TRANSFORMING shows more heterogeneity.
• HEALING protocols cluster tightly around 7.0 with anxiety and over-stimulation protocols strongest.
• THRIVING shows Focus protocols (T-FC-L3 mean 7.63) as standout performers; Creative Flow more variable.
• TRANSFORMING carries expected variability; X-MD-L3 shows unexpected strength at mean 7.15 despite low n.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Panel identifies three convergent anomalies warranting investigation.
• X-MC-L3 (n=10, mean 5.70, std 2.45) shows lowest mean across all protocols with highest variance — small sample limits conclusions but pattern is notable.
• Crisis protocols (H-CR-L1/L2/L3) average 6.46 while AutoGluon predicts ~7.96 — structural underperformance suggests entrainment curve mismatch.
• Multiple analyzers flag X-ME-L1 cross-bucket routing as consistently effective despite moderate observed scores (mean 6.74 vs predicted 8.23).
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Targeted refinements emerge from convergent analyzer observations.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] H-CR protocols (n=103 combined) — consider adding gentle theta ascent or extending hold phase to better support transition out of acute distress.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] X-MC-L3 (n=10) — investigate sample representativeness; high variance (std 2.45) may indicate population subgroup effect or low statistical power.
• X-MD-L1 (n=22, mean 6.36) — model predicts 7.88; prototype longer ascent (L2 variant) to deepen motivation entrainment.
• T-FC-L3 (n=35, mean 7.63, 71% positive) — highest THRIVING score with strong YouTube traction (15 views vs avg 4); amplify promotion.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding drift signals are pronounced, indicating evolving analytical framing.
• CROSS-RUN DRIFT: 20+ protocols show similarity < 0.85, with X-MD-L3 (0.507), H-SL-L1 (0.530), T-FC-L3 (0.532) most shifted — this likely reflects data evolution rather than analytical instability.
• CROSS-PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: Insufficient data for clustering analysis.
• Confidence: Drift metrics are reliable given consistent patterns; cluster analysis awaits more embeddings.

by_protocol_plain.H-AX-L1: This anxiety protocol works well — most listeners feel moderate improvement within 5-10 minutes. It's still being discovered on YouTube, so if you try it, you're among the first to find it.
by_protocol_plain.H-AX-L2: People who find this protocol tend to feel calmer, though reactions vary from really loving it to just feeling okay. About 1 in 5 don't notice much change.
by_protocol_plain.H-AX-L3: Steady relief from anxiety for most listeners, especially those who took a bit longer to settle. The rhythm feels especially calming to many.
by_protocol_plain.H-CR-L1: Designed for acute distress, this protocol gives modest relief — about half feel noticeably better, often within 5-10 minutes. Those who respond, respond well.
by_protocol_plain.H-CR-L2: Similar to Anchor, providing moderate help during crisis moments. The rhythm feels very settling to most listeners.
by_protocol_plain.H-CR-L3: Quick to work for some — several people settled within the first minute — but overall the relief stays moderate. The calming effect is consistent.
by_protocol_plain.H-OS-L1: The strongest performer in the whole set. Most listeners notice real improvement and many love the music. It's being found more than other protocols on YouTube.
by_protocol_plain.H-OS-L2: Effective but quietly so — most notice calm after about ten minutes. The music opinions are mixed, but the rhythm helps people settle.
by_protocol_plain.H-OS-L3: Good improvement reported with fairly consistent results. Mixed feelings on the music, but most find the rhythm comfortable.
by_protocol_plain.H-SL-L1: The sleep protocol works well for many, with quick settling and strong music appeal. A few listeners take longer, but most feel improvement.
by_protocol_plain.H-SL-L2: Works for sleep, especially used by caregivers and clinicians. Some listeners don't feel an effect, and it takes longer to settle for some.
by_protocol_plain.H-SL-L3: Similar to other sleep protocols — many feel improvement within 5-10 minutes. Music opinions are mixed but the rhythm is calming.
by_protocol_plain.T-CF-L1: For creative work, this gives modest flow support. Some feel only slight improvement, but the music connects well with many listeners.
by_protocol_plain.T-CF-L2: Strong appeal — most people love the music here. The creative flow improvement is there, especially for those who settle within 10 minutes.
by_protocol_plain.T-CF-L3: The best creative flow protocol with noticeable improvements for most. Takes about 10 minutes to settle in, and the rhythm feels balanced to nearly everyone.
by_protocol_plain.T-FC-L1: Decent focus support, though some find the rhythm slightly too active. Most notice improvement within 5 minutes.
by_protocol_plain.T-FC-L2: Step up from L1 — more people feel moderate to significant improvement. Music opinions are mixed but the focus benefits are clearer.
by_protocol_plain.T-FC-L3: The standout focus protocol. Most feel significant improvement, especially during studying or chores. Takes longer to settle but the results are worth it.
by_protocol_plain.T-MB-L1: Good baseline support for maintenance. Takes longer (around 20 minutes) for many but results are consistent around scores of 7-8.
by_protocol_plain.T-MB-L2: More variable than L1 — some feel strong improvement while others notice little. The rhythm splits opinions more here.
by_protocol_plain.T-MB-L3: Fast-working maintenance — most settle within 5 minutes. However, a notable group (4/19) didn't settle at all, suggesting different responder types.
by_protocol_plain.X-MC-L1: Mind clarity gains with strong music appeal. Most notice improvement, and nearly everyone loves the sound.
by_protocol_plain.X-MC-L2: Clarity with strong calming — over half find it very settling. The music resonates well despite only moderate scores.
by_protocol_plain.X-MC-L3: The lowest-scoring protocol with high variability. Some feel improvement but others don't, and the small sample makes it hard to draw firm conclusions. Needs more data.
by_protocol_plain.X-MD-L1: The weakest motivation protocol — about half don't feel much change. Those who do improve tend to settle quickly though.
by_protocol_plain.X-MD-L2: Similar to L1 with modest motivation support. The music is loved by many, but outcomes are variable.
by_protocol_plain.X-MD-L3: Surprisingly strong despite small sample — most feel moderate improvement. It seems to work for a specific group of listeners.
by_protocol_plain.X-ME-L1: This mood protocol is consistently flagged as effective across the board, even though individual scores are moderate. Many listeners take longer to settle (20 min) but feel energy benefits when they do.
by_protocol_plain.X-ME-L2: Good mood support with strong music appeal. Similar to L1 in that many take time but feel better once settled.
by_protocol_plain.X-ME-L3: The lowest-performing mood protocol with a notable group feeling no effect. Quick to settle but the benefits don't stick for everyone.
